        cache: npm
    - run: npm ci
    - run: npm run verifier
  dependances-npm:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v5
    - uses: actions/setup-python@v6

name: CI
true:
  workflow_dispatch: null
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
env:
  LLAMA_IP: 127.0.0.1
  LLAMA_PORT: '1'
  PIP_DISABLE_PIP_VERSION_CHECK: '1'
jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v5
    - uses: actions/setup-python@v6
      with:
        python-version: '3.13'
        cache: pip
        cache-dependency-path: requirements*.txt
    - name: Ruff, à la version de requirements.txt
      run: pip install "$(grep -oE '^ruff==[0-9.]+' requirements.txt)"
    - run: ruff check .
  typage:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v5
    - uses: actions/setup-python@v6
      with:
        python-version: '3.13'
        cache: pip
        cache-dependency-path: requirements*.txt
    - run: pip install -r requirements.txt -r requirements-dev.txt
    - name: mypy (périmètre de pyproject.toml)
      run: mypy
  tests:
    name: tests (SQLite, Python ${{ matrix.python }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        python:
        - '3.11'
        - '3.13'
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v5
    - uses: actions/setup-python@v6
      with:
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python }}
        cache: pip
        cache-dependency-path: requirements*.txt
    - uses: actions/setup-node@v5
      with:
        node-version: '20'
    - name: Prison bubblewrap (aperçus Office)
      run: 'sudo apt-get update -qq

        sudo apt-get install -y -qq bubblewrap

        # Ubuntu 24.04 réserve les user namespaces aux profils AppArmor.

        sudo sysctl -w kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0

        '
    - run: pip install -r requirements-rag.txt -r requirements-dev.txt
    - run: python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider
    - name: Service navigateur (tests Node purs, sans Playwright)
      run: node --test browser-service/test/
  tests-serveur:
    name: tests (${{ matrix.name }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
        - name: PostgreSQL 17
          image: postgres:17
          backend: postgres
          port: 5432
          user: elpis
          var: ELPIS_TEST_PG
          options: --tmpfs /var/lib/postgresql/data --health-cmd "pg_isready -U elpis"
            --health-interval 5s --health-timeout 5s --health-retries 20
    services:
      db:
        image: ${{ matrix.image }}
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: elpis
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: elpis
          POSTGRES_DB: elpis
        ports:
        - ${{ matrix.port }}:${{ matrix.port }}
        options: ${{ matrix.options }}
    env:
      ELPIS_TEST_DB: '1'
      APP_DB_BACKEND: ${{ matrix.backend }}
      APP_DB_HOST: 127.0.0.1
      APP_DB_PORT: ${{ matrix.port }}
      APP_DB_NAME: elpis
      APP_DB_USER: ${{ matrix.user }}
      APP_DB_PASSWORD: elpis
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v5
    - uses: actions/setup-python@v6
      with:
        python-version: '3.13'
        cache: pip
        cache-dependency-path: requirements*.txt
    - name: Prison bubblewrap (aperçus Office)
      run: 'sudo apt-get update -qq

        sudo apt-get install -y -qq bubblewrap

        sudo sysctl -w kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0

        '
    - run: pip install -r requirements-rag.txt -r requirements-dev.txt
    - name: Tests
      run: '# Tests propres aux moteurs serveur (tests/db…) sur le même serveur.

        export ${{ matrix.var }}="127.0.0.1:${{ matrix.port }}:elpis:${{ matrix.user
        }}:elpis"

        python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider

        '

- name: Déployer le service web
  hosts: web
  become: true
  vars:
    app_user: webapp
    app_port: 8080
    app_dir: /opt/webapp
  tasks:
  - name: Paquets requis présents
    ansible.builtin.apt:
      name:
      - nginx
      - python3-venv
      state: present
      update_cache: true
      cache_valid_time: 3600
  - name: Utilisateur applicatif présent
    ansible.builtin.user:
      name: '{{ app_user }}'
      system: true
      home: '{{ app_dir }}'
      create_home: false
  - name: Arborescence applicative
    ansible.builtin.file:
      path: '{{ item }}'
      state: directory
      owner: '{{ app_user }}'
      mode: '0755'
    loop:
    - '{{ app_dir }}'
    - '{{ app_dir }}/releases'
  - name: Initialisation one-shot (gardée par un marqueur)
    ansible.builtin.command: '{{ app_dir }}/bin/init.sh'
    args:
      creates: '{{ app_dir }}/.initialized'
  - name: Config nginx à jour (validée AVANT remplacement)
    ansible.builtin.template:
      src: templates/nginx-site.conf.j2
      dest: /etc/nginx/sites-available/webapp.conf
      mode: '0644'
      validate: nginx -t -c %s
    notify: Recharger nginx
  - name: Service nginx démarré et activé au boot
    ansible.builtin.service:
      name: nginx
      state: started
      enabled: true
  handlers:
  - name: Recharger nginx
    ansible.builtin.service:
      name: nginx
      state: reloaded
- name: Poser la crontab de purge sur les workers
  hosts: workers
  become: true
  tasks:
  - name: Purge nocturne des artefacts
    ansible.builtin.cron:
      name: purge-artifacts
      minute: '0'
      hour: '3'
      job: find /var/lib/worker/artifacts -mtime +7 -delete
